init_database_sampler: create a DataBaseSampler instance with root_path, sampler_cfg, class_names, and optional logger for 3D object augmentation
filter_by_difficulty: filter database ground truth infos by removing entries matching specified difficulty levels
filter_by_min_points: filter database ground truth infos to keep only entries with a minimum number of points per class
sample_with_fixed_number: sample a fixed number of ground truth objects from the database for a given class and sample group
call_database_sampler: run the DataBaseSampler on a data_dict to augment the scene with sampled 3D boxes and points
